exports.name: MixedPlugin

exports.name: render_one_group
exports.contract: R1 extraction of the per-group loop body: markers, render, artifact-validate, [SEGMENT_SAVED], per-group DB update. Zero chapter-terminal writes/stitch/DB rebuild — safe to call once per concurrent child.

exports.name: _is_valid_segment_artifact, _validated_wav_duration_seconds
exports.contract: PL-2 (2026-07-04): moved to app/studio_plugin_sdk/context.py; re-exported here under original names (imported directly by tests/orchestration/test_correctness_invariants.py). artifact validation gate: exists+non-zero size; WAV header duration must be 0<d<=3600s when parseable (stdlib wave, no ffprobe)

notes: 2026-07-14: render_one_group captures time.monotonic() before _render_segment and, after the group's INV-3 artifact validation passes (same point as the existing [SEGMENT_SAVED] marker), emits a new [SEGMENT_ENGINE_SAMPLE] {segment_id} {engine} {chars} {duration_seconds} marker via on_output. Never emitted for a failed/cancelled group.
marker protocol: START_SEGMENT/ENGINE_ACTIVITY_STARTED/PROGRESS/SEGMENT_SAVED drives weighted chapter progress across heterogeneous engines
INV-6: orchestrator owns performance-sample writing, handler never records metrics

handle_mixed_job unchanged in behavior: sequential loop now delegates per-group work to render_one_group but retains chapter-terminal ownership (stitch, _persist_mixed_chapter_output, final update_job)
never marks a segment done on exit code alone: rc!=0 or not _is_valid_segment_artifact(seg_out) gates completion
